name: Warm Spark
description: Cast a spark that glows warm and singes cloth where it lands.

name: Ember Ward
description: Hold a shell of charge lit with a dull ember glow that scorches the hand of those who strike it.

name: Heat Read
description: Read the warmth in a body or a blade through the charge that runs across it.

name: Glimmer Skip
description: Step away on a pulse that leaves a glowing print behind in the air.

name: Hot Lash
description: Lash with a stroke of charge that is hot enough to blister the skin it crosses.

name: Cinder Arc
description: Throw an arc that scatters glowing cinders over the target as it breaks.

name: Flare Parry
description: Turn a blow aside with a flare of heat and charge that scorches the striker's wrist.

name: Scorch Snare
description: Bind a target in a hot net of charge that burns when the target pulls against it.

name: Searing Fork
description: Drive a forked bolt white with heat through a guard and leave both wounds smoking.

name: Blaze Peal
description: Roll a peal of thunder and flame together over a wide ground so that all within burn and reel.

name: Molten Lightning
description: Strike with lightning hot enough to run like molten metal through a guard and into the body.

name: Kindled Thunder
description: streams: Lightning + Fire; both forces are lit as one thunder-flame that burns everything it rolls over.

name: Draft Spark
description: Cast a spark on a draft of air that carries it a little farther and faster.

name: Slip Hum
description: Hold a loose shell of charge that moves with the air, so blows slip past it.

name: Air Read
description: Read the air currents with a fine web of charge and find where bodies disturb them.

name: Air Bolt
description: Loose a bolt along a path of moving air so that it curves around a raised guard.

name: Draft Lash
description: Whip a lash on a rush of air that strikes from beyond arm's length.

name: Veer Parry
description: Veer sideways on a gust and brush the blow away with a charged forearm.

name: Lofted Step
description: Rise on a lift of air and charge and take a long step over the heads of foes.

name: Cutting Arc
description: Send a thin arc on a cutting edge of air that slices through a guard and what lies behind.

name: Rolling Crash
description: Roll thunder before a rushing wind over the ground and throw foes from their feet.

name: Soaring Lightning
description: Streak through the air as lightning on a wind and strike the mark before it can turn.

name: Riding Lightning
description: streams: Lightning + Wind; the bolt rides the wind so swiftly and far that it falls on its mark without warning.

name: Buried Spark
description: Send a spark into the ground so that it bursts up beneath the target's feet.

name: Rooted Ward
description: Root the body into the earth and draw a firm shell of charge up round it.

name: Seam Tap
description: Tap the earth and read through the return the seams and hollows beneath the feet.

name: Tremor Step
description: Stamp so that a small tremor throws the user a pace ahead on the rebound.

name: Tremor Lash
description: Lash along the ground so that a tremor rides the charge and unbalances the struck.

name: Rift Bolt
description: Drive a bolt into the earth so that it splits the ground along a line toward the target.

name: Grounded Parry
description: Anchor on the earth and turn a blow into it with a stroke of grounded charge.

name: Sinking Snare
description: Soften the ground under a target and wrap the sunken legs in charge to hold them there.

name: Fissure Spear
description: Run a spear of lightning along a crack in the ground and thrust it up through the foe.

name: Quake Peal
description: Strike the earth with a peal that shakes the ground and shocks all standing upon it.

name: Buried Bolt
description: Bury a bolt in the ground to wait until a foe steps over it, then loose it upward.

name: Seismic Lightning
description: Drive lightning into the earth so that the ground heaves and strikes all within its reach.

name: Quaking Lightning
description: streams: Lightning + Earth; a bolt is driven into the ground and the whole earth answers with a shuddering burst.

name: Rooted Thunder
description: streams: Lightning + Earth; thunder is rooted in stone beneath the user and holds a grounded wall of charge.

name: Mind Spark
description: Cast a spark that the user guides by thought and bends toward the mark.

name: Spirit Ward
description: Hold a shell of charge that has the grip of the will behind it and does not waver.

name: Pulse Sight
description: Feel the pulse of nearby minds as a faint rhythm in the field of charge.

name: Spirit Bolt
description: Loose a bolt that carries a trace of the user's soul and rattles the target's resolve.

name: Mind Lash
description: Lash a target with a charge that shocks thought as much as flesh.

name: Thought Parry
description: Read the intent of a blow a breath early and turn it aside with a quick arc.

name: Spirit Spear
description: Throw a spear of lightning that pierces the guard and numbs the will beneath it.

name: Mind Peal
description: Sound a peal that rings through the thoughts of all near, scattering their focus.

name: Wraith Lightning
description: Strike with lightning that passes through guard and flesh and burns the spirit within.

name: Spirit Fork
description: streams: Lightning + Soul; a forked arc strikes the body with one prong and the soul with the other.
